assumptions.assumption: Supplier is modelled as a human external entity because it is shown as an actor sending documents, and no system behavior is stated.
assumptions.basis: The diagram labels the actor "Supplier" and shows it sending insurance certificates, food safety audits and staff contact details to the portal.

assumptions.assumption: Category manager is modelled as a human external entity because it is shown as a role performing review, approval and rejection actions.
assumptions.basis: The diagram labels the actor "Category manager" and shows it performing review, approval or rejection activity.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket's data is confidential because it receives supplier data extracts containing staff contact details and supplier records.
assumptions.basis: The bucket receives a "nightly supplier data extract (CSV)" originating from supplier documents and data.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database's data is confidential because it contains supplier records associated with supplier information and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly labels the database contents as "supplier records" and shows supplier data including staff contact details entering the system.
